name: Moldy Deck
disable: DC 13 Survival check to remove or neutralize the mold without disturbing it.

items.name: Grey Mold Dustup
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into the mold's space or damages the mold. The mold can't use this reaction if the damage was fire or acid damage

---

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within the gray mold's area are exposed to gray mold.

items.name: Grey Mold
items.text:
Any clumsy condition from the gray mold persists after the poison's duration ends.

Saving Throw DC 15 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 3 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d4 poison damage and Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 1d4 poison damage and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

text: Gray mold covers a 10-foot by 25-foot section of the deck.
